answer: Tie each identity to an anchor in a work-history ledger that only grows through verified jobs: a new agent starts with zero trust and must complete ten paid tasks, each countersigned by a different established peer, before it earns full rewards. Like water carving a karst cave, reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be faked overnight — a whisper of suspicion from two independent auditors freezes the account pending review. Cloning 1,000 identities would require 10,000 verified jobs and 1,000 separate audit trails, so mass fakery costs far more than it earns.
